displayName: Niche 1: Tỷ phú / Giàu nghèo / Tình yêu vượt giai cấp
description: Tình yêu vượt giai cấp giữa cô gái nghèo và chàng trai/người đàn ông giàu (hoặc ngược lại). Trọng tâm là romance arc: gặp gỡ, hiểu lầm, rung động, dằn vặt, hy sinh, thú nhận, và công khai bảo vệ trước gia đình giàu phản đối. Ưu tiên Cinderella romance, scholarship/maid/caregiver/tutor/baker romance, hidden identity romance, public legitimacy reveal. Không phải drama hợp đồng / ly hôn / tranh quyền - các nhánh đó thuộc Niche 8.
emotionalAxis: rich-poor courtship, family opposition, class cruelty, slow-burn rung động, dằn vặt vì khoảng cách giai cấp, hy sinh vì người yêu, công khai chấp nhận trước gia đình giàu
coreKeywords: first meeting at the wrong door
he chooses her in front of the family
she walks away to protect him

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: first meeting across class lines, misunderstanding, or family opposition that ignites attraction

humiliationPacing: the rich family ranks the poor lover beneath them at the first meeting
the elite mother weaponizes class manners (forks, seats, dress code, address terms) to humiliate the lover
the gala, charity event, or country-club party is engineered to expose poverty
social media or donor circles shame the lover for daring to stand close to the heir
the rich relatives offer hush money or a 'scholarship' to make the lover disappear
the lover is mistaken for staff and ordered to use the service entrance or the back lift
an arranged match is paraded in front of the lover to break the romance
the family demands a public renunciation as the price of the heir's inheritance
the lover's job, school, or housing is quietly threatened through a board contact
the amnesiac heir's family uses his blank memory to erase the wife from his life
the dating show audience votes against her because her story is not dramatic enough
the contract countdown is weaponized by the family who reminds her daily that she is temporary
the bone marrow recipient's family treats her as a purchased organ rather than a person
the twin sister returns and the family immediately treats the younger twin as the impostor
the grandfather's will is mocked by cousins who call her a gold-digger chosen by a dead man
the psych ward staff discover his identity and suddenly treat her as an obstacle to his recovery
the sugar arrangement is leaked and her medical school classmates call her a kept woman
the mute billionaire's board uses his silence to override his wishes about her
revengeActivation: the lover proves character through quiet care, not money
he stands up to his family and chooses her publicly in the same room she was insulted
she walks away first to protect his future, forcing him to fight for her
a hidden identity reveal restores public dignity to the underdog lover without selling the romance for status
the rich heir refuses the family-approved match in front of the assembled relatives
the gala turns into a public confession where class no longer outranks love
the poor lover saves the family from a real crisis without asking for status in return
the heir publicly returns the inheritance condition and chooses partnership over allowance
the family realizes the lover's character is what kept the heir from a worse marriage and asks her to stay
the amnesiac heir's journal is found proving he chose her before the accident — his past self defends her
the dating show airs unscripted footage and the audience reverses their vote
on day ninety-nine neither signs the exit papers and the silence becomes the confession
the bone marrow donor refuses the gratitude money and the heir realizes love is not a debt
the twin sister publicly admits she ran because the groom looked at the younger twin first
the grandfather's sealed letter reveals he saw them meet as children and chose her for love not lineage
the mute billionaire signs his confession in front of cameras because his voice failed but his hands did not
the single father's child calls her mom at the school open day and the heir lets it stand
the psych ward patient returns as a billionaire and his first call is to the nurse who never treated him like one
dignityRecoveryTiming: late-arc public reveal where the rich-side lover defends the poor-side lover in front of the disapproving family, sealing the romance with chosen legitimacy rather than money or contracts
